note: Super Smash Bros. Melee art for the randomizer, all in-game art from the game itself (Nintendo, HAL Laboratory), never fan art. Fighters: the character select screen's player-slot portraits, one per costume, from Super Mario Wiki (mariowiki.com, Gallery:Super Smash Bros. Melee, 'Preview images'; files 'SSBM Icon fighter preview <name> c<n>.png'). The game has no such portrait for Sheik (she's picked by holding A on Zelda), so Sheik has none and the randomizer shows Image coming soon. Stages: SmashWiki's in-game stage views taken with the game's debug camera (ssbwiki.com, Category:Debug menu (SSBM), the '-NRML-' files), cropped to 16:9. Header: the official group artwork (Super Mario Wiki, File:SSBM.jpg), cropped to 16:9. Run scripts/pull-melee-art.ts.
